prior_importants.description: A dropped task still raises its top-rung need: `topRungFailure` in src/core/dashboard.service.ts only checks the task row exists, and the dashboard reads tasks via `listTasks` (which includes dropped rows), so after `pup plan drop` the "re-plan or pup launch" need never clears.

process_issues.description: The skill roster includes review-simplicity and review-guards, and both were spawned and returned. The CI --json-schema area enum (correctness/security/conventions/context/maintainability/docs/spec) has no value for either, so they are left out of reviewers_spawned/reviewers_returned. Guards found nothing. Simplicity returned one low-confidence readability nit: the redundant `AND NOT EXISTS` guard on dropTask's DELETE in src/core/session.repository.ts. It was dropped at consolidation because the reviewer conceded that keeping the code as is was fine. The tools/review schema needs the two new areas.
